scope: mechanical identification, contact segregation, and value comparison

workflow.title: Identify assembly
workflow.instruction: Confirm relay, contactor, switchgear, or contact-bearing component and document it intact.

workflow.title: Check resale/whole value
workflow.instruction: Compare intact component value before dismantling, especially for industrial or specialty parts.

workflow.title: Open mechanically
workflow.instruction: When economically justified, use appropriate hand tools to expose contacts without heating, burning, or grinding unknown materials.

workflow.title: Separate fractions
workflow.instruction: Keep contact tips, copper, brass, steel, coils, and plastic housings separated and labeled.

workflow.title: Treat contact alloy as unknown
workflow.instruction: Do not assume a silver-colored contact is pure silver. Record source and route uncertain alloys for testing or professional assay.

workflow.title: Weigh and compare
workflow.instruction: Record separated contact weight and compare specialty buyer/refinery terms with the intact-item value.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Use Worth My Time? before repeating the process across a batch.

hazard_policy: Unknown contact alloys may contain hazardous metals. Avoid dust-producing or thermal processing and use appropriate professional testing/refining routes.
